Dear ICMP Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Internship at ICMP. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content creation, and social media coordination, I am eager to contribute to ICMP's mission of defending music publishers' rights worldwide.

At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build WordPress sites for client projects. On mirook.com, I designed and launched a multi-page site, integrated social media, and implemented structured data to improve visibility across search engines and AI platforms. My technical background in web design and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) allows me to craft content that resonates both with audiences and algorithms.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and work fluently in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level. I am excited about the opportunity to support ICMP's communications efforts and learn from your team.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear ICMP Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Communications Internship at ICMP. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am drawn to ICMP's mission of defending the rights of music publishers and songwriters globally. The opportunity to contribute to communications for an organisation representing 90% of the world's music is deeply compelling.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that grows organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites, ensuring content is optimised for both search engines and user engagement. This experience has honed my ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and strategically.

On my personal project, mirook.com, I designed and launched a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimisation, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. I also integrated social media channels (Instagram/Facebook) to amplify the site's reach. This project demonstrates my ability to manage a communications ecosystem from the ground up.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and work professionally in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level. My technical skills in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) allow me to create content that resonates with both audiences and algorithms. I am eager to bring this blend of creativity and technical insight to ICMP's communications team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to ICMP's important work.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
